item.summary: Coinbase reported net income of 718.7 million US dollars for the third quarter of 2026, up from 432.6 million a year earlier. About 715 million dollars of that came from gains on crypto assets the company holds as investments. Total revenue fell 35 percent from a year earlier to about 1.22 billion dollars.
